meta.name: time
meta.description:
Command execution timing — microsecond precision, statistical analysis, comparison.
Zero barrier — use with x-cmd or shell built-in time command.
Use for "timing", "benchmark", "performance", "profiling".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 测量命令执行耗时，微秒级精度，支持统计与对比
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要精确测量命令执行时间并做统计分析
copy.tagline_en: Measure command execution time with microsecond precision, statistics, and comparison
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise command timing with statistical analysis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以测量命令执行时间，支持微秒级单次计时和多次运行统计，还能比较多个命令的性能。
howto.when: 当你提到“计时”、“基准测试”、“性能”、“性能分析”等关键词，或要求测量命令执行时间时触发。

say.text: 帮我测量一下 `ls -R /` 的执行时间。
say.note: Claude 会执行单次微秒级计时。

say.text: 比较 `grep` 和 `awk` 处理大文件的性能。
say.note: Claude 会运行多次统计并对比结果。

say.text: 对 `curl example.com` 做 100 次压力测试。
say.note: Claude 会执行 100 次并输出完整统计。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can measure command execution time with microsecond precision, perform multi-run statistical analysis, and compare multiple commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "timing", "benchmark", "performance", "profiling", or ask to measure command execution time.

say_en.note: Claude will perform a single microsecond timing.

say_en.text: Compare the performance of `grep` and `awk` on a large file.
say_en.note: Claude will run multiple times and compare results.
Claude will execute 100 runs and output full statistics.
